download_download_urls: download one or multiple URLs and return the local file paths
download_extract_archive: extract an archive file and return the extracted directory path
download_download_and_extract: download a URL and automatically extract the archive in one call
download_kaggle_data: download a Kaggle dataset or competition archive to the download directory
download_iter_archive_files: iterate over files within an archive yielding path and file handle tuples
